## Definition check

The "Reproducibility" section is present in my instructions and reads as expected of the current instrument. The sentence beginning "Repeatability must be", verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

It names both the evaluator model *and* the definition as things that must be held fixed, and disclaims the fixed/zero-temperature guarantee — so my definition is current, not the pre-#1077 vintage. Recorded `instrument_sha256` as `9d08b5f3…0e7dd3`.

## Result — CHORUS, claudecode_api, rep1

**67 / 88 points.** Both bases are equal at **76.1%** (fixed denominator 88; adjusted denominator 88), because **no question was excluded** — `excluded_max_points: 0`, `questions_not_applicable: 0`.

All four trigger conditions resolved as met, each on evidence outside the gated question's own fields (anti-circular rule):
- **Human subjects** (gates Q8, Q15) — met via `description`, `keywords`, `collection_mechanisms`.
- **Datasets shared** (gates Q10, Q17) — met via `distribution_formats` (5 formats) and `data_governance.access_review_process`.
- **Software output** (gates Q11) — met via `external_resources` naming the 28-repository chorus-ai GitHub organization.
- **Collection + shared** (gates Q12, Q13) — met via all four collection fields plus the sharing condition.

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness | 19 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content | 17 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation | 17 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility | 14 / 21 |

Highest: Q7 funding (5) and Q12 collection protocol (5). Lowest: Q13 versioning/sustainability (2) and Q20 bias documentation (2). Semantic analysis logged 11 issues (20 consistency checks passed, 4 failed, 8 warnings); grant number OT2OD032701 validates as well-formed NIH, DOI and RRID are absent, and one external resource lacks a URI scheme.

Two judgements worth flagging as non-mechanical. **Q19 scored 4 despite absent versioning** — this record inverts the 3-band's assumption by having lineage without version history, and entity/activity/agent are all recoverable from text, which the rubric accepts. **Q8 held at 3 with no IRB** — the band nominally reads "IRB + deidentification", but deidentification, privacy, at-risk identification and sensitivity classification are all substantive here, offsetting the missing IRB rather than dropping below the band; the missing DPIA, HIPAA determination and `informed_consent` prevent any rise above it.

## One process note

The first validation run failed: `'description' is a required property` at Q20. That was a serialization omission on my part — the key was dropped when I wrote the file — not a judgement. `Edit` is disabled this session and the Bash permission layer repeatedly refused to execute a small fix script, so I rewrote the file via `Write` with the `description` restored and **every score, label, evidence string and note unchanged**. Nothing was altered to satisfy the validator.
